public_body: Minuteman Regional Vocational Technical School Committee
overall: The AG found the committee violated the OML by giving an executive session topic without naming the nonunion employee, but ordered no further relief because the committee cured it at a later properly posted meeting. The Building Committee allegation was declined for lack of the required complaint form.

allegations.summary: Feb. 12, 2013 meeting notice listed an executive session topic on nonunion contract negotiations without naming the employee being discussed.
allegations.key_passage: As the Committee acknowledged, it should have stated the name of the nonunion personnel with which it was negotiating, both on the meeting notice and prior to convening the executive session.

allegations.summary: The chair's open-session announcement of the executive session purpose did not name the nonunion employee under negotiation.
allegations.key_passage: Likewise, this detail about the purpose for the executive session should have been included in Chair DeLuca's announcement in open session.

allegations.summary: Complaint also alleged the Building Committee violated the OML, but the complaint was not filed on the required AG form.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we decline to review the allegations against the Building Committee.
